standard: CDC NSSP-style emergency department line list; HHS Protect-style daily hospital capacity with power and fuel status; daily syndromic counts; CDC NWSS-style wastewater surveillance
notes: Seven emergency departments under their facility_registry.json ids. Visit_Date and Report_Date are local calendar dates (US Central); Arrive_Date_Time is UTC. Chief complaints are free triage text; CC_Category is the keyword category a syndromic system assigns. syndrome_summary.csv is an exact daily count of the line list. eas_broadcasts.csv in the same folder belongs to the eas_alerts stream.
entity_catalog: registries/facility_registry.json (facilities[] with facility_type_code HOSP-ED), registries/areas.json (ZIP and census-tract areas), registries/infrastructure_assets.json (WW-01 to WW-05)

field_notes.CC_Category: GI, RESP, SKIN, IRRITANT, INJURY, CO, HEAT, RENAL, CARD, NEURO, ABD, MSK, FEVER, MH, GU, OB, ENT, MEDS, OTHER
field_notes.Patient_Tract: home census tract code (areas.json AREA-TRACT-<code>); blank for patients from outside Nueces County
field_notes.Disposition: Discharged, Admitted, Transferred, Left without being seen

field_notes.Staffed_Beds_Available: staffed beds the hospital can operate that day
field_notes.Census_Target: pre-storm discharge target, when one was set
field_notes.ED_Visits_24h: emergency department arrivals on that local date (equals the line list)
field_notes.Fuel_Hours_Remaining: on-hand diesel divided by the current burn rate

field_notes.Area_ID: areas.json AREA-ZIP-<zip> of the patient's home

field_notes.concentration_gc_per_L: gene copies per litre of the target
field_notes.pmmov_gc_per_L: pepper mild mottle virus, the faecal-strength normaliser
field_notes.report_date: date the laboratory result was reported

joins.Patient_ZIP / Patient_Tract / Area_ID: areas.json; water districts are ZIP groups there

coverage.cadence: per visit; daily; daily; two to three samples a week per plant (sampling suspended while plants were flooded or without power)
